name: Himitsu no FakeRing
source:
You were working as a contract employee for a major general company when suddenly one day you are told that your contract is terminated due to the company's reasons.  

In addition, you have to move out of the apartment you are living in. 

You have lost your job and your house at same time. 
You are at a loss as to what to do next, when your childhood friends, Haru and Minami, appear.  

The two men, who are willing to help you, suddenly propose "marriage." 
However, there is a condition to the marriage... 

Haru is mean but sometimes kind, and Minami is a gentleman and a prince. 

You are in a tight spot. Which proposal will you accept? 
And what is the future for you and him...?! 
You will fall in love with him at the mercy of these two sadistic men. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3750660/The_Secret_Fake_Ring/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一家大型综合公司的合同工，突然有一天你被告知由于公司原因你的合同被终止。

此外，你必须搬出你所居住的公寓。

你同时失去了工作和房子。
当你儿时的朋友春和美波出现时，你不知道下一步该做什么。

两个愿意帮助你的男人突然提出“结婚”。
不过，结婚有一个条件…… 

Haru很刻薄，但有时也很善良，而Minami是一位绅士和王子。

你处境艰难。你会接受哪一个建议？
而你和他的未来又会怎样……？！
你会在这两个虐待狂的摆布下爱上他。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3750660/The_Secret_Fake_Ring/]Steam[/url]]
